description: MainActivity.kt defines the main activity for an Android calculator app, managing UI components such as voice input, calculator keypad, and history drawer. It handles user interactions like input processing, expression evaluation via CalculatorEngine, and dynamic history display.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: Primary activity managing calculator UI, voice input, and history drawer.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes UI components, sets up voice search, calculator keypad, and history panel.

methods.name: updateResultBox
methods.description: Updates the display of the current expression.

methods.name: evaluateAndShowResult
methods.description: Evaluates the current expression, displays the result, and updates history.

methods.name: wireCalculatorKeypad
methods.description: Sets up button click handlers for calculator keys, including expression evaluation.

methods.name: setupHistoryPanel
methods.description: Initializes the history drawer toggle button and overlay.

methods.name: showHistoryDrawer
methods.description: Displays the history drawer with animation and populates it.

methods.name: hideHistoryDrawer
methods.description: Hides and removes the history drawer with animation.

methods.name: populateHistoryDrawer
methods.description: Fills the history drawer with stored calculation history, adds clear button functionality.

methods.name: updateHistoryPanelIfVisible
methods.description: Refreshes history display if the drawer is open.

methods.name: onActivityResult
methods.description: Handles activity result, including voice input results.
